title: GenerateExtendResult
description: One `generate.extend` candidate's result blob (specs/09-generation.md §6): every gate's verdict, the metrics the eval dashboard tracks, and what placement needs. The candidate audio is the sibling asset in the same `JobOutputs` entry. The blob is uploaded as `blobs.candidate_<index>` and published with the candidate's asset on the streaming `partial` event (09 §5).

index.description: Candidate index within the job, in the order partials were published.

asset.description: The processed candidate audio (48 kHz, 24-bit FLAC).

seed.description: The seed the backend actually used, echoed for regeneration and HQ re-render.

passed.description: Every non-skipped gate passed. A rejected candidate can still be returned, with qualityWarning (09 §6).

qualityWarning.description: Set when no candidate passed: the UI shows "This one might not blend perfectly" (09 §6).

seamScore.description: 03 §8.2 seam score of the final render, lower is better. null when the gates could not score the candidate; JSON has no Infinity.

tempoError.description: Relative tempo error before warping, 0..1 (0 when it could not be measured).

spliceOffsetSamples.description: Where the processed audio starts relative to the context edge being extended: the context end for forward, the context start for backward. Negative means it starts inside the overlap (09 §6, 03 §8.2).

ExtendStepList.description: The seven gate verdicts of 09 §6, in order; short-circuited steps are skipped.

step.description: Gate name: sanity, tempo, key, beat_align, splice, match or final_seam.

skipped.description: True for a step after a short circuit.

reason.description: Why a gate failed, e.g. "silent" or "tempo error above the gate".

metrics.description: The gate's own numbers. Deliberately open: each gate owns its metric names (config/generation_gates.toml).

shiftSemitones.description: Semitones the key gate shifted the candidate by (0, +-1).

ExtendKeyRelation.description: How the candidate's detected key relates to the requested one (09 §6 step 3).

amount.description: Wet amount of the spectral match, 0..1.

ExtendMatchEqBands.description: One gain in dB per band of the `match_eq` fx (03 §8.2).
